subject: Re: EmberCloud security intake — data flow, logs & CAIQ questions
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@embercloud.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Cc: security@embercloud.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: EmberCloud security intake — request to schedule call and list of asks

Hi Alex,

Thanks for onboarding EmberCloud for the evaluation. We're doing a standard security intake ahead of procurement and would like to schedule a 30–45 minute call to walk through a handful of items and gather documentation for our SIG/CAIQ/QSA review.

High-level asks:
- High-level architecture / tenant dataflow (how customer data traverses Redwood infra)
- Retention policies and where logs are stored (sample logs if possible)
- Auth & IAM: SSO/SAML, role mappings, rotation cadence for keys
- Encryption in transit & at rest (KMS usage, HSM if applicable)
- SOC 2 status and any recent auditor report summary
- Any third-party subprocessors and subprocessors' country locations

We can be flexible on timing — proposed windows (Pacific):
- Tue 11/17 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–14:45
- Wed 11/18 09:30–10:15

Please let us know who from Redwood would join (security, product, engineering) and any pre-read you can share (CAIQ draft or SOC2 summary). If you prefer, send a calendar invite and we will accept.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Security Manager, Vendor Risk
EmberCloud
laura.chen@embercloud.com

---
Attachment: ember_intake_template_v2.docx (they attached their intake form)

From: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@embercloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: EmberCloud security intake — request to schedule call and list of asks

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. Happy to jump on a call. Suggested attendees from our side:
- Alex Martinez (Security/Pre-sales)
- Marissa Cole (Product, infra controls)
- Mina Haddad (Privacy & compliance)

We can cover the architecture, retention, logs, and our SOC 2 posture.

Proposed time: Tue 11/17 at 14:00 PST — I can send a calendar invite for 45 minutes and include a brief agenda:
1) 10m introductions & scope
2) 20m dataflow, retention, logging and IAM Q&A
3) 15m CAIQ/SOC2 evidence and next steps

Pre-read we will share before the meeting: SOC 2 summary (redwood_soc2-summary.pdf), a draft CAIQ mapping (redwood_caiq-responses-draft.xlsx), and a high-level network/dataflow diagram (network-dataflow-diagram.vsdx).

Quick question: is EmberCloud able to accept a small sample of anonymized access logs (redacted) ahead of the call, or would you prefer we provide schema + examples only?

Thanks — I'll send the invite once you confirm the slot.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Security Architect, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

- David Nguyen, Sr. Security Engineer (will lead technical Qs)

-David
